source: 影响临床药物相互作用的因素概述_姜晓言.pdf
text:
药后病情更加恶化，有些患者服药后出现了不良反应，均有可能是药物之间的相互作用引起的。影响药物相互作用的因素较多，大体可分为性别、年龄及药物的配伍禁忌与相互作用，本文从以上几个方面总结了影响药物相互作用的因素，以期为临床用药指导提供理论参考。
Clinical Overview of Factors Influencing Drug Interactions/JIANG Xiao-yan.//Chinese and Foreign Medical Research，2015，13(13)：130-132【Abstract】　Drug interactions refers to the effect changes in two or more than two kinds of drugs at the same time.Namely synergistic(synergistic)， additive(increased)，antagonist(reduction) effect.Rational drug interaction can enhance curative effect or reduce adverse drug reactions，and can increase the efficacy or toxicity reduction，may also occur in some of the adverse reaction，interference treatment，aggravating illness.Effect of increasing called the efficacy of synergistic or additive effect weakens，called the efficacy of the antagonist，also the title of ‘incompatibility’.Drug interactions are common，some patients after taking the condition worse，some patients after taking some medicines，the emergence of adverse reactions，are likely to be caused by drug interactions.There are many factors that influence drug interactions，can be roughly divided into the gender factor，incompatibility with the interaction of age and drugs，this paper summarizes the factors affecting drug interactions from the above aspects，in order to provide a theoretical reference for clinical medication guide.First-author’s address：Shengli Petroleum Administration Bureau Community Supply Hospital，Dongying 257024，China doi：10.14033/j.cnki.cfmr.2015.13.067药物有其各自固有的作用和疗效特点，但是它又受许多因素的干扰或影响 [1]。机体方面的因素是导致药品不良反应的重要因素，人体的生理因素(遗传、性别、年龄等 ) 及病理因素对药物的药效学 ( 机体的敏感性 ) 及药动学(药物的吸收、分布、代谢和排泄)均可产生影响 [2]。如果机体对药物的敏感性增加或药动学参数的改变，使药物的血药浓度上升，均可使药品在正常用法用量下出现药品的不良反应 [3]，这是导致药品不良反应的重要因素。人体的生理因素 ( 遗传、性别、年龄等 ) 及病理因素对药物的药效学(机体的敏感性)及药动学(药物的吸收、分布、代谢和排泄)均可产生影响。如果机体对药物的敏感性增加或药动学参数的改变，使药物的血药浓度上升，均可使药品在正常用法用量下出现药品的不良反应。本文将影响临床药物作用的因素概述如下。
